'''Una Clan''' or '''House Una''' was a famous [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] family on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Among its members were [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]]<ref name="Kryptos" /> and [[Ob Fortuna]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TMA" /> "Una" meant "graceful" in [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]].<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
